_doc: TIME: the simulation clock. One clock tick is 15 simulated minutes, so a day is 96 ticks; a timed job lasts ceil(minutes / minutes_per_tick) ticks. The day and year lengths are the simulation's own calendar convention (a 360-day year split by season_start_day), not a sourced calendar (APPROX). season_start_day gives the first day of each season within that year. ticks_per_period is the default number of ticks the village runner advances per published period (one day, as before the move).
